title: Build your game anywhere
author: AirportLoo
selftext:
Hey guys I(claude) built an open source tool that lets you control your computer from your phone. I know there are already apps on android but not many for IOS. It runs on your browser and connects to your computer using tailscale. It has a dedicated “APP” page for claude and codex with more to come that simulate their official apps in a mobile and lets you see all your current chats and send new messages/requests. I personally found it kind of annoying to have to go back to my desktop when I need to add a prompt of if i’m out and have to wait to get home. This isn’t perfect, but it’s a work in progress and hopefully it helps some of you.

[Here is the repo](https://github.com/theclasscoder-eng/PocketDesk)

Some SS of what it looks like on mobile are attached
